title: pgsc_calc: polygenic scores (PGS Catalog)
description: Calculates polygenic scores for target genomes with the PGS Catalog Calculator from the University of Cambridge and EMBL-EBI. The example scores synthetic genomes for a UK Biobank height score. Options that download scores or reference panels need internet access and are not offered.

input.title: Samplesheet
input.description: CSV samplesheet describing the target genomes. Leave empty to use the bundled CINECA synthetic chr22 example.

target_build.title: Genome build of the target genomes

scorefile.title: Scoring file
scorefile.description: A PGS Catalog scoring file in the workspace, for example imported through Airlock. Leave empty to use PGS001229 (standing height) for chr22.

min_overlap.title: Minimum variant overlap
min_overlap.description: The fraction of score variants that must match the target genomes.
